name: creative-videomasking
title: Creative Video Masking
blurb: Looping video with a custom SVG mask that creates a shaped cutout effect.
description: Plays a muted, auto-looping video clipped by an embedded SVG mask. The mask creates an irregular geometric shape. CSS mask-image and -webkit-mask-image ensure cross-browser support.
use_when: Hero sections or visual transitions where video content needs a creative, non-rectangular shape.
avoid_when: Browsers without CSS mask support, or when the mask shape itself needs to be interactive or dynamic.
a11y: Video is muted and autoplays. Purely decorative. No controls or alternative content.
